question: What distinguishes the measures of mantra-lords and great mantra-lords?
premises: mantra-lords' measure is devoid of that prior impression
great mantra-lords' measure is power itself as instrument
higher rungs shed residue, then coincide with power
inference: Ascent thins the impression until measure and power coincide.
uncertainties: tatsamskara antecedent (v15 refinement) inferred from sequence
plain_english: The mantra-lords' measure is devoid of that impression; the mantra-great-lords' measure is called power as instrument.
